An essay on the three pictured cultural objects: why each matters to the culture (it carries history and tradition — traditional clothes show the makers' skill, instruments let a community share feelings and stories), what each symbolises (respect for ancestors, friendship and unity, family/faith/community), and finally what connects all three — creativity and the wish to keep traditions alive, culture, identity and shared values that grow over time.
